verdict.rationale: Square documents taking in-person card payments on its own hardware and through its Mobile Payments SDK, Terminal API and Tap to Pay on iPhone. Community comments also describe its card reader plugging into a phone to read cards. None of the evidence describes the actual flow of pairing a reader with the POS app or registering a device to an account, or how quickly a first payment can be taken. Missing for 10: documented reader pairing or Bluetooth setup flow, device registration to an account, evidence of minutes-to-first-payment onboarding, hands-on corroboration.
